thread:
maria: kicking off a progressive 10% -> 30% -> 60% ramp for v4.0-nf4-int8 on the summarization pipeline. want to land a hysteresis policy that reduces flapping from noisy slices.
oz: good call. seen too many tiny blips trigger rollbacks. what do you have in mind for hysteresis?
maria: two-layer hysteresis: metric smoothing (EWMA with alpha=0.2) + tiered rollback actions based on magnitude and persistence.
jun: propose severity buckets: green (<=0.2% delta) no-op, amber (0.2-0.8%) hold/rate-limit, red (>0.8%) rollback. but require persistence windows: amber must persist 20m, red must persist 2 consecutive 5m windows.
ops: include noise floor per-slice. some slices (low volume) naturally jitter. we should adjust significance by effective sample size and use a z-test for delta.
ml-eval-bot: suggestion: calculate z = (p_model - p_base) / sqrt(p_pool*(1-p_pool)/n_eff) where n_eff = min(n, 2000) to avoid tiny-sample overreaction.
oz: love that. also add KL divergence on token distribution as a secondary signal for hallucination-style regressions. e.g., KL>0.015 triggers amber for content drift.
maria: adding escape routes: soft mitigation = reduce canary to previous step (e.g., 30%->10%), hard mitigation = full rollback to pinned v3.9-int8. and a quarantined-slice mode where traffic for the offending slice is pinned to fallback.
jun: operational detail: how do we avoid oscillation when metric bounces just around threshold? need cooldown timers on each action (don't promote again for 60min after a rollback).
ops: yes. cooldown + increasing backoff: first rollback cooldown 60m, second within 6h -> 6h cooldown.
maria: pasting a minimal policy blob to feed into deploy-bot/gatebook. this should be machine readable.
```json
{
  "canary_steps": [10, 30, 60],
  "smoothing_alpha": 0.2,
  "buckets": {
    "green": {"delta_pct_max": 0.2, "action": "none"},
    "amber": {"delta_pct_min": 0.2, "delta_pct_max": 0.8, "persist_seconds": 1200, "action": "step_back"},
    "red": {"delta_pct_min": 0.8, "action": "rollback", "persist_windows": 2, "window_seconds": 300}
  },
  "noise_floor": {"min_sample": 50, "n_eff_cap": 2000},
  "kl_secondary": {"metric": "kl_token_dist", "threshold": 0.015, "action": "amber"},
  "mitigations": {"step_back_to": "previous_step", "slice_quarantine": true},
  "cooldown_minutes": 60,
  "backoff_minutes": 360
}
```
deploy-bot: ACK. I'll validate schema and attach to the rollout job. will also emit #auto-rollback and create a channel if rollback occurs.
ml-eval-bot: plan: run hourly human-eval on a stratified sample (200 docs split by short/long/guide) and push concordance + qualitative labels.
ojun: for telemetry, record z-score, delta_pct, kl, n_eff, and per-slice volume. add a derived field `action_confidence` combining z and kl. we can threshold action_confidence>1.6 for red.
oz: one more: user-visible latency SLO must be checked too. if p99 increases >50ms absolute -> immediate pause and fall back. keep latency gating orthogonal.
maria: agreed. one-seat check: if amber triggers but n_eff < 100 and z-score borderline, do automated human-in-the-loop: create a triage task assigned to oncall for 15m triage before action.
ops: sounds operationally safe. document will ship to gatebook and I'll update runbook with triage steps and who to ping.
maria: thanks all. we'll monitor the next 2 hours. post summaries here every 15m. :white_check_mark:
